translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Yawe, mnc-xglex nim nztu-krme mz nibrnge.
X bzkq rlrpx-ngrn nzaovxiokr enqmi rngeng ninge.
Lalztqm bange mz nzokatr-krm ninge.
X arlapx ninge murde tubq-esz'ngrn.
Nangini-kzp me rlakitrx mz nzmnc-kapqtr-krbo bam.
Murde nim butqbr x lrpalvc nyznge.
Gct rnge, arlapx ninge mz mq leplz kxdrka'-ngrng,
Kcng tzrpilr naodatilr ninge.
Murde nim, Kxetu Yawe, kx brti drtwrnge, yzutr pnz mzli kc tqngi-oblabe-ngrne.
X sc tqvzbe nzabrtr-krbo drtwrnge bam.
Abzo mzli kc tzmcngr mzke', krlzmle mzli ka, mnc-xgletxpwo nim,
Mz nzaclve-zvz-krm ninge. Delc naglqlz-zvz-ngrne nim.
Nzrpi leplz kx ninge rkx ngr da kxtrka,
A' nim lrpalvc kxmqngi kx rlakitrx.
X glqlz-zvzx nim mz zbq kang kqlu,
Mz nzyapwxtipx-krnge nzmyalz-esz'ngr-krm.
Delc kxmule-esz' nipenge lrtzlvz, a' bzkq drtqm satrp bange,
X bzkq rlaszq ninge mzli ka tqyangrngape-ngrne.
Murde enqmi rngeng nzycmnetr-ngrdr ninge
X nzryrlqpeng drtwr,
Mz nzrpi-krdr kx, “Gct sc tqrlaszpele nide.
Vzmamu, nalolvzpeku murde trpengr kx na-arlapxle nide.”
Gct rnge, bzkq mnc-rlrume bange,
A' vz-anim mz nzarlapx-krm ninge.
Aovxio x odati krkcng tzrpilr natzlr x na-atrkatilr ninge,
Mz nzamyati-krbzme drtqdr x nzbatr-krbzme nzobqszokr leplz nidr.
Sa na-abrtr-zvzbo drtwrnge bam,
X naglqlz-ebir-ngrne nim.
Kxmule-esz' da kcng tqaleq nzkqlu-zlwzng,
A' mz zbq kang kqlu sa nayapwxtipxx nztubq-krm, x zmatq ngrm mz nzarlapx-krm leplz.
X sa navzbo bam mz nzglqlz-krnge zmatq ngrm,
Murde nim txpwz kx tubq-esz'ngr.
Gct, alvztrq ninge, abzo mzli kc tqngi-oblabe-ngrne.
X sc tqyapwxtipxbex da kx nzkctitxpx kcng tqwz-ngrn.
Mzli ka nipenge lrtzlvz x nqnginarnge prkipe, bzkq rlaszq ninge.
A' mncm bange mz nzyapwxtipx-krbo zmatq ngrm mz nrpr ngr leplz amrlx.
Gct, nzetukr nztubq-krm krlzlzle bongavz.
X trpnz-moungr kx apule nim kc tqaleti da kxetuting.
X kxmule-esz' batrpe' nzetukr nzkxpu-krngeng, a' krlzx kx sa na-amrna-mowq nzlu-krnge,
Mz nzarlapx-krm ninge mz gq.
Sa na-aetunepxbzme nzamatqkr leplz ninge,
Mz nzaelalz-mou-krme drtwrnge.
Gct rnge, nim Gct rgr, nigr lr Israel, x sa nangrbo bam mz nzayrni-krbo gita x ukzlele.
Tr-esz'ngrn x sa naglqlzx nim murde ngida angidrme bagr.
Sa namalq-katox mz nzabrtz-krnge,
X mz nabznge atwrnrngr sa nangrbo bam murde arlapxpeq ninge.
Mz zbq kang kqlu sa napipxbo nztubq-krm mz nzokatr-krm ninge.
Murde krlcng tzrpilr na-atrkatilr ninge aovxiopeqng x drtqdr myape.
